objective: Bring Elune's Tear to Pelturas in Astranaar.

description: I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child.  We must find more powerful medicine!  Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar.  Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, <name>, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
progress: <name>, did you find Iris Lake? Do you have the Tear?
completion: Oh, you found it! I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.
